name: describe_branch
description: Get a tree view of all objects in a branch, including databases, schemas, tables, views, and functions. Do not use when you only need table names (use `get_database_tables` instead) or column detail (use `describe_table_schema` instead).

branch_id.description: An ID of the branch to describe

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

project_id.description: The ID of the project. Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.
